mapper.select: SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}

SELECT prj_id,sum(lbr_cst_amt::numeric+drct_expns_amt::numeric) AS amount,count(DISTINCT dev_id) AS people FROM cst.cst_aloc WHERE cst_ym=#{month} AND prj_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY prj_id ORDER BY prj_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cst.mth_cst WHERE cst_ym=#{month})
SELECT plan_ym,trgt_sls_amt,trgt_bsn_prft_amt FROM fin.biz_plan WHERE plan_ym=#{month} AND bsn_part_id IS NULL

INSERT INTO ai.frcst_exec(frcst_ty_cd,base_ym,frcst_mnth_qty,asmptn,scnro_yn,official_yn,exec_at) VALUES(#{type},#{month},#{months},CAST(#{assumptions} AS jsonb),'N','Y',#{now}) ON CONFLICT(base_ym,frcst_ty_cd) WHERE official_yn='Y' DO NOTHING RETURNING frcst_exec_id
SELECT count(*)>1 FROM fin.mth_cls_hist WHERE cls_ym=#{month} AND cls_prcs_cd='CLOSE'

SELECT e.base_ym,r.obj_ym,e.frcst_ty_cd,r.mid_val FROM ai.frcst_exec e JOIN ai.frcst_rslt r ON r.frcst_exec_id=e.frcst_exec_id WHERE e.official_yn='Y' AND r.obj_key_val='' AND r.obj_ym=#{month} ORDER BY e.base_ym,e.frcst_ty_cd
